title: How to get to Courmayeur?
claims: A public bus connects Chamonix and Courmayeur in both directions, operated by Flixbus and Arriva; the page recommends public transport over driving into Courmayeur.
Turin Caselle airport is about 150 km from Courmayeur, Geneva about 115 km and Milan Malpensa about 212 km.
From Geneva airport, a Flixbus service runs directly to Courmayeur; from Turin or Milan, the suggested route is train to Aosta and then bus to Courmayeur.
Aosta is connected directly to Turin Porta Nuova and Turin Porta Susa in under 120 minutes; Milan to Aosta takes about 180 minutes with a change at Chivasso.
Until 13 December 2026, the rail service between Ivrea and Aosta is suspended and replaced by buses due to electrification works.
